verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares has a first-party Gusto integration that syncs hiring, onboarding, and equity data, so employee information does not need to be re-entered. It also grants equity automatically from offer-letter promises, which covers the new-hire half of the story. Missing for 10: evidence that terminations/offboarding flow into equity records, any HRIS beyond Gusto (e.g. Rippling), details on sync frequency or field mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
